passage_text: Pip and Ned get set to dash. Pip and Ned dash past the big oak. Ned is quick. Pip is quick too. Pip spots a stone. Pip stops to look at the stone. Ned gets to the oak first. Pip is a bit sad he did not win. Ned grins and waits for Pip. Ned and Pip sit by the oak. It was fun, not just a win.
